Container.Name: GameNight
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted multiplayer party games for your living room: any phone, tablet, or laptop on your LAN becomes a controller. Create a room, share the 6-letter code or invite link, and play.
Ships five games: Mongolpuri (social deduction, 4-15 players), UNO, Quiz (15-question trivia), Tic Tac Toe (with tournament brackets), and Scribble (draw & guess).
Features reconnect support, spectator mode, 100 avatars, and per-game host settings. No accounts, no persistent data. Note: the Quiz game fetches its questions from opentdb.com, so that one game needs internet access; everything else is fully local. No authentication by design — keep it LAN-only.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the GameNight web UI. Everyone on the LAN opens this to create or join rooms.
